title: He Was Given a Way to Everything. See What He Chose

meta.name: v5_k18_13_the-journeys
meta.title: He Was Given a Way to Everything. See What He Chose

lines.text: He was given a way to everything. See what he chose.
Dhul-Qarnayn travels to where the sun sets, then to where it rises.
Indeed We established him upon the earth, and We gave him to everything a way.

quran.ar: إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُۥ فِی ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَءَاتَیۡنَـٰهُ مِن كُلِّ شَیۡءࣲ سَبَبࣰا

lines.text: But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of Paradise, and we will speak to him from our command with ease.

quran.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحࣰا فَلَهُۥ جَزَاۤءً ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۖ وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُۥ مِنۡ أَمۡرِنَا یُسۡرࣰا

lines.text: And ease for those who do good.
